Sub: Guidelines regarding issue of Vigilance Clearance in respect of officers and staff 
working in various offices of the Organisation - regarding. 
Ref: 
i. HO Circular No. Vig. XIX (1)2015/VCC/1406 dated 06.05.2015. 
ii. HO Circular No. Vig. XIX (1)2014/Gen/173 dated 23.01.2017. 
ii. This Office letter No. Vig. XIX(1)2014/Gen/717 dated 12.04.2017. 
Sir, 
Please refer subject & references cited above. 
2. 
The Vigilance Wing of Head Office issued guidelines concerning issuance of Vigilance Clearance 
Certificate in respect of 'B' & 'C' Group employees vide circular dated 06.05.2015 under references (i) 
above, which envisaged that only in cases of officials wherein CPFC/Chairman, CBT (EPF) is the Appointing 
Authority/Disciplinary Authority, the VC shall 
be 
given by the Vigilance Wing, 
H.Q through 
Chief Vigilance Officer. 
Subsequently, vide letter under reference (ii) above it was clarified that the 
RPFC-1, being the Disciplinary Authority/Appointing Authority shall issue VCC in respect of Group 'C' & 'D' 
employees. Vigilance Wing, H.Q further clarified vide letter dated 12.04.2017 under reference (iii) above 
that ACC or RPFC-1 shall issue VCC in respect of Group 'B', 'C' & 'D' employees for whom they are the 
Appointing/Disciplinary Authority. 
3. 
However, after cadre restructuring, some filed offices have sought clarification regarding issuance 
of VCC in respect of Group B & C officials in respect of offices headed by RPFC-II level Officers. In this 
context, the Competent Authority has decided that until further orders ACC (Zone) will issue the VCC in 
respect of Group 'B', 'C' & 'D' officials of the offices headed by RPFC-II level officers after obtaining 
Vigilance Status from the offices where the official has worked in the concerned Zone. 
[This issue with the approval of Central P.F. Commissioner]
